module: Flowgraph node "Audio Channel Fade" (tags sound/audio/volume, icon audiotrack). Fades the volume of an FMOD audio channel (default 'AudioChannelMaster') toward silence or toward the previous volume, with more control than the Fade In/Out nodes. Inputs: flow, fadeDown (goes down to volumeMin), fadeUp (goes back up to volumeMax), duration (s, default 1), channel, volumeMin (default 0) and volumeMax (default 1) hidden. Outputs: fadeDone (flow) and volume (current volume). Runs every frame (work). Uses an internal timer (mgr.dtReal) for compatibility reasons.
notes: Old pins renamed (legacyPins): fadeTime -> duration, fadeIn -> fadeDown, fadeOut -> fadeUp (the fadeIn/fadeOut mapping seems inverted relative to the meaning, but that is what the code does).
If fadeDown and fadeUp are active at the same time, the mode is 0 (no fade).
When the graph stops, the channel volume is set back to its base value (getChannelVolume(channel, false)).
If volumeMax is not provided, the fade-up target is the channel's "unfaded" volume.

reset.desc: Resets the timer, mode, volumes and channel.

_executionStopped.desc: When the graph stops: restores the channel's base volume then reset().

work.desc: Every frame, if flow is active: reads the channel volume, detects a mode change (down/up), advances the timer and applies Engine.Audio.setChannelVolume by linear interpolation; sets fadeDone to true at the end.
